# Fixtures

Responses from the MOBY Dublin GBFS 3.0 feed, captured on 2026-09-26 at about
11:28 UTC from `https://moby-move.rideatom.com/gbfs/v3_0/en/gbfs?id=2023`.

`geofencing_zones.json` is minified. The other files are pretty-printed with
`jq`. The data is published under CC-BY by Dublin City Council / Smart Dublin.

`probe/vehicle_status_1118.json` and `probe/vehicle_status_1121.json` are two
responses from the same day, three minutes apart (11:18 and 11:21 UTC). Some
vehicles are in one response and not in the other.
